description_en: Creates a version for a policy
description_zh: 调用CreatePolicyVersion接口为权限策略创建新的版本
kebab_example: aliyun ram create-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --policy-document Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1 --set-as-default false --rotate-strategy None --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePolicyVersion

parameters.help_en: The document of the policy. The document can be up to 6,144 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 权限策略内容，最大长度6144字节
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set this policy as the default policy. Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 是否设置为默认权限策略，默认值为`false`
parameters.name: set_as_default

parameters.help_en:
The rotation strategy of the policy. The rotation strategy can be used to delete an early policy version.

Valid values:

`None`: disables the rotation strategy.

`DeleteOldestNonDefaultVersionWhenLimitExceeded`: deletes the earliest non-active version if the number of versions exceeds the limit.

Default value: `None`
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略版本自动化轮转机制，可以删除历史权限策略版本。

目前包含：

`None`：关闭轮转机制。
`DeleteOldestNonDefaultVersionWhenLimitExceeded`：当权限策略版本数量超限时，删除最早且非活跃的版本。

默认值：`None`
parameters.name: rotate_strategy

PolicyVersion.description_en: The information about the policy version
PolicyVersion.description_zh: 新建的权限策略版本的信息

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the policy version was created
CreateDate.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

IsDefaultVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the policy version is the default version

VersionId.description_en: The ID of the policy version
